update: Download moss-editor-<version>.tgz, contract.d.ts and SHA256SUMS from the moss-multi GitHub Release and check the tarball against SHA256SUMS. If SHA256SUMS does not list contract.d.ts (it doesn't from 0.2.0), check it against contract.d.ts in the build run's moss-editor-host artifact instead. Replace vendor/moss-editor/ with the tarball's moss-editor/ folder and vendor/moss-editor.contract.d.ts with contract.d.ts, and update every field here. The server refuses to serve the editor unless every file matches editor.json.
